title: Seahawks CB Josh Jobe fined twice for unnecessary roughness in Super Bowl LX

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks CB Josh Jobe fined twice for unnecessary roughness in Super Bowl LX
sources.description: Seahawks cornerback Josh Jobe was the only player fined for on-field infractions during Super Bowl LX and Jobe picked up a pair of them for unnecessary roughness on one play in the fourth quarter of the game.
